preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to access owner-only functions

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call multipleBotlistAddress() function with an array of victim addresses and set excluded=true to blacklist them. This will prevent blacklisted addresses from sending or receiving tokens through the _transfer function, which checks require(!_isBlacklisted[sender] && !_isBlacklisted[recipient]). The owner can selectively freeze any user's ability to trade while maintaining their own trading ability.
